title: Bodycam: New Mexico Cops Chase the Wrong Guy
description:
Bodycam footage shows New Mexico police confronting a man riding a bicycle on January 11. Albuquerque officers mistook Xavier Benitez for another suspect wanted on an arrest warrant. Benitez, although the wrong guy, allegedly fled from officers after they ordered him to stop. Benitez pleaded not guilty to charges stemming from this case of a mistaken identity gone wrong. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
